command_or_source: App commit 95eeb993f855b4c0f69e9cb858c6ec0f1d2e4f9c: bash scripts/test.sh with MockShortcutPermissions, MockKeyboardShortcutRemapTap, MockTrackpadShortcutPoster, ManualScheduler and MockAlerts.
result_summary: Injected accessibility denial, event-tap creation failure and event-tap recovery failure all preserve the saved mapping. Denial and creation failure leave listening stopped with a specific notification; recovery failure removes only the remapping tap and reports that listening stopped. The existing shortcut service remains independent.
limitations: A real mid-session TCC revocation and an operating-system CGEventTap timeout were not induced on the development machine.
